items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: This is when I was with Fredrick Coleman band. Oh yeah. At the Mardi Gras. We worked there three years with Fredrick.

ctx.x: I remember when Lawrence had a band. Yeah, that's right. He died right after, remember? Yeah, just two years ago. That's Sam Dutré. Yeah, Sam, yeah. Yeah, that's a good picture. Yeah.
This is when I was with Fredrick Coleman band. Oh yeah. At the Mardi Gras. We worked there three years with Fredrick. You know that the Mardi Gras by Silverville? Yes, I remember.
About next to where I'm at now?
